description: Daily flying program and mission sortie schedule for UK F-35 squadrons. Links pilot flight rosters with assigned airframes to facilitate operational tail-swap reallocations when aircraft are grounded by maintenance alerts.

fields.name: sortie_id
fields.description: Primary Key (PK): Unique daily flying program task identifier (e.g., SRT-MAR-20261103-01).

fields.name: scheduled_departure_utc
fields.description: Partition Key (DAY): Scheduled engine start and take-off timestamp in UTC (e.g., 2026-11-03T06:30:00Z).

fields.name: assigned_tail_number
fields.description: Foreign Key (FK -> airframe_component_telemetry.tail_number, Cluster Key): Currently planned primary aircraft tail assigned to the sortie (e.g., ZM151).

fields.name: assigned_pilot_callsign
fields.description: Designated combat pilot name and tactical radio callsign (e.g., Flt Lt Henderson / VIPER-1).

fields.name: spare_tail_candidate
fields.description: Pre-designated serviceable spare airframe (e.g., ZM154, 842.0 flight hours, Mission Capable) ready for immediate tail-swap.

fields.name: sortie_readiness_status
fields.description: Cluster Key. Valid status enums: 'PMC-M' / 'AT_RISK_MAINTENANCE' (Partial Mission Capable - Maintenance Required), 'MC' / 'MISSION_READY' (Mission Capable), or 'REALLOCATED_SWAP_CONFIRMED'.
